_about: Blacklist tab. funds: the team's manual list of funds to avoid, one entry per fund: scheme_code (AMFI / api.mfapi.in code, e.g. 103174) and an optional reason. rules: thresholds for the automatic flags (NAV-based criteria); any key left out uses the default in scripts/build_json.py BLACKLIST_RULE_DEFAULTS. Category keys are slugs (large-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, multi-cap, value-contra, dividend-yield, ...). weights: default % of each rule in the Blacklist Score (a fund's score = total weight of the rules it fails; viewers can change weights on the page). min_score: default cut-off; funds at or above it are listed.
